title: Momoi Airi — It Wasn't Enough〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Park
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... I made it to the turnaround point.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was pretty exhausted last time, but I feel good today. I guess that means my stamina's improved...

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Girl
rows.Line: Mom, this way! Hurry!

rows.Speaker: Girl's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, I'm coming. Where would you like to take a picture next?

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Girl
rows.Line:
The flower beds!
I'll look cuter if I'm surrounded by flowers, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. She's so full of energy. She must be having a little photo shoot with her mom.)

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Girl
rows.Line: I wanna look just like my favorite model, Na, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That reminds me of all those times I had Mom take pictures of me. I remember having so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Actually, I think we took some at this park...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Oh, now I remember.
When I was preparing for my very first audition...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Do you have the camera, Mom?!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
I have it right here.
Oh, Airi, wait. Your bangs are a bit of a mess.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Didn't I warn you not to run?
Here, I'll fix them now.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
No, I'll fix them myself!
Look, I even made sure to bring a mirror!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, you're so prepared.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: That's because we're taking my application picture! I also brought my makeup kit just in case I need to do some touch-ups.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (Let's see... Brush this tuft to the right, and... Oh, this bit's sticking up again.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Alright, that should do it...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: My bangs are all set, and my makeup's on just like I practiced! So, uhh... I should be in my “best condition”!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna pass my audition and become a dazzling idol...!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: And that means we've gotta get amazingly cute pictures of me!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. Let's both do our best.
So, where would you like to take them?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: About that...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
Here we are! The Scramble Crossing!
I want to look like a fashionable “city girl”, so...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Mom, let's take one in front of this big poster!

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Okay.
Try posing for me now.

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: This seems like a nice spot. It gives us a wonderful view of the sea.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! For this one, I wanna change things up by trying to look more grown-up.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Just like the girl on this magazine. Take a picture when my hair's all fluffed out!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Park

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Look a little more to your right for me... Perfect! Hold still...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, you look very cute...
You're so good at making these adorable expressions, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Really? Lemme see!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (I tried going for a “natural” look since I play at this park all the time.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: (And Mom just said she really liked my expression, so I bet it turned out...)

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: What's wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: This isn't the smile I imagined...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: But why? Was I acting too meek...?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, you do seem more well-behaved than normal.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: But I'm always well-behaved!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line:
I might've been feeling a little anxious.
Can we try retaking that, Mom?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Mother
rows.Line: Of course. We can keep trying until we get the picture you want.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Airi
rows.Line: Thanks!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We ended up shooting for like three days.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Mom made room in her busy schedule to spend all that time with me...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Ever since then, I've kept doing what I can to make my dream a reality. I'm standing here right now because I worked so hard.)

rows.Speaker: Girl's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, I think this one turned out really nicely. Take a look.

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Girl
rows.Line:
Yeah, it did!
But I still feel like I can make a more natural expression...!

rows.Speaker: Neighborhood Girl
rows.Line: Because I'm definitely gonna be a dazzling model just like Na someday!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still need to keep trying harder and harder.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So I can tell little me that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I became a dazzling idol, just like she wanted.
